instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. In a brightly lit room decorated with Canadian flag bunting, a group of friends is gathered. On the left, the man with short brown hair (R1) in a blue-gray corduroy shirt smiles, looking towards the center. Next to him, the woman with dreadlocks (R7) in a pink shirt and olive vest laughs and gestures. In the center-right, the Black man with a red bandana (R5) in a brown shirt smiles with his arm around the man with glasses (R4), who stands on the right in a white sweatshirt looking left. On the far right, a partially visible bystander with curly hair has his arm around the man with glasses. Bright, natural indoor lighting fills the scene.
